places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Deets guards the penned horses watching the moon while Dish slips off to the Dry Bean, where Lorena wins at cards.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town; the Hat Creek corral lies about two hundred yards from the Dry Bean saloon; plains around it

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Jasper Fant is a cowboy from upriver.

places.name: Matagorda
places.note: Deets has often glimpsed the ocean there.
places.location_hint: Texas Gulf Coast around Matagorda Bay

places.name: Fort Phantom Hill
places.note: After the terrible battle there, Deets dreamed Indians moved the moon beside a low west Texas hill.

places.name: West Texas
places.note: Deets pictures its many small low hills in his dream of Indians mounting the moon.

places.name: Pecos River
places.note: Deets thinks of it as one of the few alkaline rivers.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Xavier notes Mexican women are plentiful across south Texas; Jasper jokes Mexicans could retake Texas with the Captain away.
